title: Break Me Off a Piece
author: Jonah Pearl
problems: Row 1 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 1 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.

figures.text: robins allemande left 1½ around while the larks orbit clockwise ½ around
larks start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends - robins ricochet
robins start a half hey - rights in center, lefts on ends - larks ricochet -- look to new neighbors
neighbors do si do 1¼ and form an ocean wave.
